changelog: **`/admin/analytics/executive` — four deterministic sponsor scores** (#1895, part 2 of 2; docs/executive-dashboard.md). `GET /api/admin/analytics/executive` (ADMIN-only in the handler, `entitled(orgId, 'ADVANCED_ANALYTICS')` → 403 `feature_locked`, tenant as a hand-written conjunct) returns Engagement, Progression and Placement as `100 × numerator ÷ denominator` over the relations active in each of six equally long periods (the selected one and the five before it), with both counts. Engagement uses the one contact rule — `relationsInContactBetween()` added to `src/lib/lastContact.ts`; Progression counts forward moves on the tenant's on-path order; Placement counts first entries into the resolved finished stage (#1882). Capability is reported as not measurable until #1822/#1823 exist — no proxy metric. The arithmetic is pure in `src/lib/executiveScores.ts` (`scripts/test/executive-scores.test.mjs`). Each card shows its trend as CSS bars, a one-line delta and a "How is this computed?" affordance with the sentence and the expression; nothing is labelled predictive. Prints to one A4 page in EN/TR/DE (`#executive-print`), asserted by `e2e/admin-executive.spec.ts`.

en: New Executive dashboard for admins: Engagement, Progression and Placement as scores from 0 to 100, each with its trend and the exact arithmetic behind it — ready to print on one page for sponsors.
tr: Yöneticiler için yeni Yönetici panosu: Etkileşim, İlerleme ve Yerleştirme 0–100 arası skorlar olarak, her biri eğilimi ve arkasındaki hesapla birlikte — sponsorlar için tek sayfada yazdırılabilir.
